title: Simons' identity B.8 for minimal hypersurfaces in frame-free ambient form: Δ_M|A|² = 2|∇A|² − 2|A|⁴
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ with IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M for every r ∈ ℕ; let ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M; and assume trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0 for every x ∈ M. Throughout: P_y is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M y), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], |A|²(y) := Σ_j |Dν(y)(P_ye_j)|² (Dν = fderiv ℝ ν), δ_jg(y) := fderivWithin ℝ g M y (P_ye_j). Let C(y) := Dν(y)∘P_y, D_aC := fderivWithin ℝ C M x a, |∇A|²(x) := Σ_{i,j,k}((D_{P_xe_k}C)(P_xe_i)·P_xe_j)² and Δ_Mg(x) := Σ_j δ_j(δ_jg)(x). Then for every x ∈ M: Δ_M|A|²(x) = 2|∇A|²(x) − 2(|A|²(x))².
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ ν x).toLinearMap) = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, (∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν z ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M z)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) M y ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) = 2 * (∑ i : Fin P, ∑ j : Fin P, ∑ k : Fin P, (inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2) - 2 * (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) ^ 2
